sourceEvidence.title: New Ujjwala 2.0 Connection — eligibility and documents
sourceEvidence.issuer: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas / PMUY
facts: Applicant must be a woman aged 18 years or above.
No other LPG connection from any OMC may exist within the same household.
Applicant must belong to a poor household based on prescribed deprivation declaration.
Page lists KYC, applicant Aadhaar, family-composition proof, adult family members' Aadhaar, address proof where required, bank details and deprivation declaration.
Migrant applicants may use prescribed self-declarations for address and family composition.

sourceEvidence.title: PMUY official FAQ
sourceEvidence.issuer: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas / PMUY
facts: FAQ Q1–Q2 describes adult woman from poor household and says the deprivation declaration is the basic criterion for poor household.
FAQ Q1 ties no-existing-LPG check to any family member listed in the family-composition document.
FAQ Q6 lists KYC, Aadhaar of applicant and adult family members, address/family-composition evidence, bank details and deprivation declaration.
FAQ Q17 says biometric Aadhaar authentication is mandatory at the LPG distributor.
FAQ Q31 says PNG connection holders cannot receive a PMUY connection or a non-PMUY subsidized LPG connection.
FAQ Q3 lists security-deposit-free connection, no installation charges, cylinder, regulator, hose, DGCC booklet, free first refill(s) and free two-burner stove.

sourceEvidence.title: PMUY deprivation declaration
sourceEvidence.issuer: PMUY / Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
facts: Form contains a deprivation checklist and exclusion criteria; the complete checklist must be reviewed by human reviewers and not reduced to a generic poverty checkbox.

sourceEvidence.title: PMUY About page — 25 lakh connection extension and eligible household categories
sourceEvidence.issuer: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas / PMUY
sourceEvidence.publishedOrRevised: Live page checked 4 November 2026; no page revision date stated
facts: Government approved an additional 25 lakh LPG connections, taking the stated overall target to 10.6 crore; the page says these connections are being released.

The page lists eligible adult-woman household categories including SC, ST, PMAY-G, Most Backward Classes, AAY, tea/ex-tea garden tribes, forest dwellers, island/river-island residents, SECC AHL TIN and poor households under the 14-point declaration.
Applicant must be at least 18 and there must be no other LPG connection in the household.
The page lists KYC, ration card or family-composition evidence, Aadhaar of applicant and adult family members, address proof and bank account/IFSC.

sourceEvidence.title: PMUY official eKYC page — face-based Aadhaar authentication
sourceEvidence.issuer: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas / PMUY
sourceEvidence.publishedOrRevised: Live page checked 4 November 2026; no page revision date stated
facts: The official page describes self face-based biometric Aadhaar authentication (eKYC) using the Oil Marketing Company mobile app together with Aadhaar FaceRD.
This process must be reconciled with PMUY FAQ language about biometric authentication at the distributor; do not assume one replaces the other.

sourceEvidence.title: PMUY live homepage — 25 lakh extension progress and assistance amounts
sourceEvidence.issuer: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas / Oil Marketing Companies
sourceEvidence.publishedOrRevised: Portal achievement figures as at 23 September 2026; home page checked 4 November 2026
facts: Homepage reports 2,442,525 connections released under the latest 25 lakh extension as at 23 September 2026.
Homepage benefit section states cash assistance of ₹2,050 for a 14.2 kg connection and ₹1,300 for a 5 kg connection, plus free first refill and stove.

The official About page separately states ₹1,600 and ₹1,150 respectively; these official pages conflict. Do not encode a benefit amount until the current governing order/OMC instructions are reconciled.

boundaryTests.scenario: Woman aged 17 years 364 days vs 18 years on application date
boundaryTests.expected: Under-18 must not pass; exact date-of-birth evidence belongs to official process.

boundaryTests.scenario: Adult woman with a poor-household declaration but an LPG connection held by any family member in the family-composition record
boundaryTests.expected: Not a potential match; household-level check must be complete.

boundaryTests.scenario: Applicant belongs to poor household but only a male adult is available
boundaryTests.expected: FAQ says no PMUY connection; verify exact current policy wording.

boundaryTests.scenario: Migrant applicant uses prescribed self-declaration for address/family composition
boundaryTests.expected: Apply only the published migrant exception; do not generalize to other documents.
Follow FAQ Q31 restriction; official OMC confirmation required.

boundaryTests.scenario: Deprivation checklist contains any exclusion or unknown response
boundaryTests.expected: needs_verification until current form and decision rules are independently reviewed.

amendmentsReviewed.item: Live PMUY FAQ checked 04.11.2026; page does not state revision date.
Official deprivation declaration PDF identified; full legal/operational checklist approval remains outstanding.

unresolvedQuestions: Obtain the Cabinet/Ministry order for the additional 25 lakh allocation and verify the current remaining allocation and application window.

Reconcile the ₹2,050/₹1,300 amounts on the live home page with ₹1,600/₹1,150 on the About page using the latest governing order and OMC instructions; do not display a single amount as authoritative until resolved.
Confirm the current deprivation declaration form version and every checklist item; do not infer poor-household status from income alone.
Reconcile FAQ biometric-at-distributor language with the face-based self-eKYC app process and any distributor KYC requirements.
Confirm the PNG connection restriction and household membership rules with current Ministry/OMC instructions.
JanaSetu must not collect Aadhaar copies, Aadhaar numbers, OTPs, bank details, ration-card images or family Aadhaar data; route applicants to authorized OMC/CSC channels.
